description: We are a team of four girls studying artificial intelligence, And we are passionate and always hope for the best.
summary: TerraTwin is a web platform that finds places on Earth that match landing and exploration sites on the Moon and Mars. It uses open satellite data from NASA and JAXA. We compared 464 Earth sites with 31 Mars targets and 30 Moon targets, using four physical criteria and an AI terrain model, and found 347 new candidate analog sites. Space teams can use TerraTwin to choose the right place on Earth to test rovers, landers, drills and instruments before they fly.
details:
The problem

Before a rover or a lander goes to the Moon or Mars, it must be tested on Earth. Today, analog sites are often chosen by experience or description, not by measured data. If the test ground does not match the real target, the machine can fail on the mission, and nobody can fix it there.

Our solution

TerraTwin measures the similarity between Earth and space sites with real satellite data:

Four physical criteria: slope, surface roughness, albedo (surface brightness), and thermal swing (day–night temperature difference).

Fair comparison: each world is normalised separately, so Earth, Mars and Moon values can be compared on the same scale.

AI terrain model: a deep vision model (DINOv2) compares the shape of the terrain from elevation patches.

Abiotic gate: sites with vegetation (NDVI) are excluded, because the Moon and Mars have no plants.

How it works

Earth was divided into regions of about 17 km (3×3 pixels at 0.05°).

For each region we calculated the mean values of the criteria from MODIS and elevation data.

Mars and Moon target sites were built from MOLA, LOLA, Diviner, GRS and LEND data.

The similarity score ranks every Earth region against every target.

Results

464 Earth sites: 411 scanned regions and 53 known analog sites.

31 Mars targets and 30 Moon targets.

347 new candidate sites.

ROC-AUC: 0.875. Recall on known sites: 33.3% (4 of 12).

15 sites rejected by the NDVI gate.

Website pages

Home: 3D Earth, Mars and Moon, with key results and the similarity ring.

Site Finder: pick a Moon or Mars target and see its closest Earth twins on a map.

Compare Sites: an Earth site and a space target side by side, criterion by criterion.

Analog Lab: build a field kit from real space hardware, check it against the ground, see what Earth cannot reproduce (gravity, radiation, dust), and export a test plan as a PDF.

Evidence & Method: data sources, method and validation.

Guide + AstraBot: a step-by-step guide and an AI assistant with guided tours.

Tools used

Python, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, three.js, Leaflet, Google Earth Engine (terrain patches), DINOv2, GitHub and Netlify.

Benefits

TerraTwin lowers cost and risk for space missions, gives researchers a data-driven way to choose test sites, and is honest about what Earth cannot simulate.
